title: ITシステム基礎
subtitle: IT Systems Basic
educationalGoal: This course is designed to achieve the learning and education goal of IT Management Fundamentals in the Department of Management Information. Its purpose is to train students who have a fundamental level of knowledge and skills in information technology on the user side. The topics are essentially those covered on the IT passport test, as indicated by the keywords shown here.
advice: As management essentials, students will learn development technology, project management, and service management. As technical elements, students will acquire knowledge of algorithms, computer systems, human interfaces, multimedia, databases, networks, and security. Students are expected to use the self-study questions (past IT passport tests) on the CD that comes with the textbook. Students will also be expected to attend lectures related to regional cooperation (software development) and write reports.
books: Textbooks will be announced before class starts.
requiredKnowledge: It is strongly recommended that students apply to take the IT passport test. It is advisable that students obtain reference information published online and respond in a planned manner.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the overview of the IT passport test of the information processing engineer test.
Be able to understand the outline of specialized fields studied in the Department of Management Information.
Be able to understand the knowledge and items related to system development technology.
Be able to explain knowledge about computer systems.
Be able to explain knowledge about networks and security.
Be able to understand the relationship between corporate management and information networks.
